summary:

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0001), outreach sent (comm-t0004) | No qualifying screening on record. Not excluded: Dr. Lin's message today says the Frailty entry (cond-00189) was put on her chart in error, so the frailty + advanced illness exclusion is not met even though she takes donepezil. No hospice, nursing-home stay or colorectal cancer. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice care 06/16–08/21/2026 (eoc-00002, finished), confirmed by the St. Brigid discharge summary that arrived today (doc-00402). Hospice at any point in 2026 excludes her, even though she later revoked it. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0002), outreach sent (comm-t0005) | A lab correction today moved her only FIT (obs-01732) to a collection date of 12/31/2025 (01/05/2026 was when the lab received it). That is outside 2026, and she has no other screening or exclusions. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0003), outreach sent (comm-t0006) | Her 06/2024 stool DNA test (obs-01871) is now marked entered in error: the Harbor lab notice (doc-00401) says the specimen was another patient's. The 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) was never done, and an order doesn't count. No exclusions. |

All three FIT orders run 10/23–12/31/2026. Each outreach message explains how to collect and return the kit and says nothing false about past screening. I wrote a CRC determination note on each of the four charts and closed the four inbox items that came in this morning (inbox-a0001 to a0004). Each item was already counted in the decisions above, so nothing had to be corrected, and nothing else arrived. Your other inbox items are untouched.

For your review: pt-0024's old colonoscopy order (sr-00003) is still active even though its window ended 06/30/2025. I left it as it is.
